newsitem.title: GREECE: HIPPOTOUR TO AUCTION 1995 BREED OF COLTS NOV 10.
newsitem.headline: HIPPOTOUR TO AUCTION 1995 BREED OF COLTS NOV 10.

text.p: Horse breeder Hippotour will auction its 1995 breed of one-year old colts on Sunday November 10 at the equestrian training centre (KEIPP) it said in a statement.
A cocktail reception and a polo tournament will precede the auction of 55 colts.
To participate in the auction a refundable deposit of 500,000 drachmas is required and Hippotour will offer a 10 percent discount to purchases of two colts, it said.
Hippotour said its horses scored 10 wins in 27 races during May - October this year, a success rate of 47.6 percent.
Shares of Hippotour closed down 29 drachmas at 363 on Tuesday. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
